title: New phone users tap Google or GitHub but never get signed in
whatHappens: The person taps Google or GitHub, leaves for the provider's page, and never comes back to Beeline signed in.

fixes.text: Sign-in recovers after a failure, and Android gets the Google account picker
Android Google sign-in works after leaving the app and returning
GitHub sign-in is freed when the person leaves the GitHub page
Prove on an Android emulator that brand-new Google and GitHub users finish sign-up on production

observations.text: 28 days: 29 outside installs tapped Google or GitHub; 8 got in and 6 reached the app.
Last 48 hours: 6 outside phone attempts on 5 installs; none came back from the provider. The account-picker fix did not help.
22-28 Oct: 20 outside installs tapped, 6 got in (14 lost, 2 a day). The log starts 22 Oct, so there is no prior week to compare.
29 Oct: 18 installs tapped, 4 got in. This day may include our own emulator sign-up tests.
